**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**The AP Manager leads the Accounts Payable team and is responsible for ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely processing of supplier invoices and payments globally, safeguarding financial integrity and operational efficiency. The role ensures high-quality Accounts Payable execution across the team, oversees month-end and audit processes, and acts as the escalation point for suppliers and internal stakeholders. As part of Shared Services, reporting to the Head of P2P, this position leads a team of 7 FTEs across multiple entities and is accountable for financial governance, KPI performance, and driving the function's transition from manual to automated, scalable processes. The role is a full-time position and reports to the Head of Procure to Pay.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Lead, coach and develop a team of 7 FTEs across the Accounts Payable function.

• Approve journals and oversee approval of new vendors and vendor changes.

• Own the monthly close process for Accounts Payable, ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

• Manage and delegate audit deliverables across quarterly, interim, and yearly cycles.

• Maintain control and oversight of the supplier invoice workflow, including monitoring and clearing backlog to keep processing on track.

• Own KPI reporting and performance tracking, providing visibility to the Head of P2P and key stakeholders.

• Drive continuous improvement, leading automation and process projects to move the function towards scalable, less manual ways of working.

• Ensure adherence to company policies, financial controls, and regulatory requirements, maintaining strong governance within the AP function.

**KEY EXPECTATIONS

**In this role, you take full ownership of your team's output and workload distribution, manage complex operational and people challenges, and drive process improvement across the function. You lead rather than execute - setting direction, removing blockers, and holding the team accountable to a high standard. You build the case for change, adapt quickly when priorities shift, and are a dependable leader who drives both team performance and function-wide results.

**OUR BENEFITS

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

• Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

**ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Genmab is searching for an energized Senior Associate to be part of Global Clinical Supply, Portfolio & Project Delivery team in Copenhagen within commute distance from our office locations to work according to your hybrid work arrangement.

With an impressive pipeline and many ongoing clinical trials, you will have a central role in supporting inspection readiness across our late-stage clinical development portfolio. Your work will help ensure that documentation is complete, compliant and readily available to support the successful execution of business-critical GMP and GCP inspections.

You will support inspection readiness activities within Global Clinical Supply, collecting, organizing and performing completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation. During inspections, you will participate in back-office activities and help ensure timely retrieval and follow-up of requested information.

The role also offers opportunities to develop beyond inspection readiness. Working closely with Clinical Supply Managers in the Portfolio & Project Delivery team and colleagues across the department, you will support selected operational tasks and initiatives while gaining broader exposure to clinical trial management. Through collaboration with Clinical Trial Operations and CROs, and hands-on involvement in clinical supply activities, you will further develop your GCP and clinical supply knowledge.

The position is based in Copenhagen.

**Responsibilities

**

• Support inspection readiness across late-stage clinical trials by collecting, organizing and maintaining relevant clinical supply documentation.

• Perform completeness and compliance checks of trial-specific documentation against applicable procedures and inspection-readiness expectations.

• Participate in back-office activities during GMP and GCP inspections, including document retrieval, request coordination and tracking of responses and follow-up items.

• Support preparation for mock inspections, audits and health authority inspections, including compilation and review of supporting documentation for completeness and readiness.

• Support activities related to day-to-day trial management, including coordination, follow-up and preparation of relevant material and documentation.

• Support distribution and logistics, including tasks related to shipment documentation, in alignment with the Drug Supply Managers.

• Build knowledge of especially GCP but also GMP and clinical supply activities within Global Clinical Supply, Portfolio & Project Delivery function

• Participate in maintenance and continuous improvement of procedures, tools and ways of working supporting inspection readiness and clinical supply activities.

• Responsible for being compliant with Genmab´s quality system.

**Requirements

**

• Minimum a bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

• Some experience working with documentation, quality or compliance activities in the pharmaceutical, biotech, clinical research or another regulated environment is an advantage.

• Knowledge and understanding of GCP and GMP; experience with inspection or audit readiness is an advantage.

• Strong interest in documentation, quality and compliance, with a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work.

• Ability to coordinate activities, maintain structure and follow up on actions involving multiple stakeholders.

• Ability to work successfully under pressure in a fast-paced environment and with tight timelines, including during inspections.

• Ability to be proactive, enthusiastic, curious and goal orientated, with a willingness to learn new GCP/GMP-related activities.

• A team player with demonstrated ability to work effectively cross-functional with internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong communication skills in English - both oral and written.

**The Team

**You will be part of a highly competent team focused on end-to-end trial management including planning and maintenance of supplies for clinical trials, working closely with cross-functional stakeholders in both CMC and Clinical Trial Operations.

Together with Global Clinical Supply Manufacturing and Global Clinical Supply Systems, the teams make up the Global Clinical Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK544.000,00---816.000,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

We run the world's largest open customer review platform, and while we've come a long way, there's still so much exciting work to do. Come join us at the heart of trust!

We’re a leading online reviews platform, free and open to all. Our mission is to be a universal symbol of trust. We are well on our way - but there’s still an exciting journey ahead of us. Do you want to join us at the heart of trust?

We’re currently looking for a Senior UX researcher to join our team at Trustpilot.

Our goal is simple: to become the most trusted reviews platform in the world. We will achieve this by being ready and willing to disrupt ourselves through innovation, data and insight and adding product professionals with ambitions that match our own.

As Senior UX Researcher, you'll be the go-to expert on measuring how people and businesses experience trust on Trustpilot , from reading a review to deciding our platform is worth paying for. You'll own the quantitative research agenda for your product areas, set the bar for statistical rigour across the team, and partner with Data Science to build a shared measurement culture.

What you'll be doing:

Research strategy & execution

• Design and own the quantitative research roadmap for your product areas, e.g.  attitudinal measurement, behavioural analysis, and longitudinal tracking.

• Lead large-scale surveys (validated scales, NPS derivatives, trust-perception metrics) and log-data/behavioural analytics (funnels, A/B tests, cohort and retention modelling).

• Build measurement frameworks that define what ‘good’ looks like for review-reading, purchase-decision, and business-subscription journeys  and track them over time.

Quantitative methods

• Lead advanced quantitative research - surveys, behavioural analytics, experimentation, predictive modelling  using statistical rigor as the throughline, from validated instrument design through to automated, auditable analysis pipelines (Python/R/SQL).

• Pioneer AI-assisted techniques (e.g. LLM-assisted open-text analysis) where they genuinely sharpen the work, evaluating any AI tooling with a critical eye on validity and bias.

Standards, influence and coaching

• Partner with Data Science and Analytics on shared definitions and data pipelines; hold the bar on study design and statistical rigour across the team.

• Translate statistical output into clear, decision-forcing narratives that PMs, designers, and engineers act on.

• Coach other researchers in quantitative methods, raising the team's statistical literacy through pairing and structured feedback.

What we're looking for:

• 4+ years of UX research experience with a strong specialisation in quantitative methods and complex, broad-scope work.

• Strong survey methodology (instrument design, sampling, psychometric validation) and statistical grounding (regression, factor/cluster analysis, significance testing).

• Hands-on proficiency in Python, R, or SQL, and direct experience with large behavioural datasets (e.g. Amplitude, Looker, BigQuery).

• A track record of quant research that measurably shaped product or business decisions, including A/B testing methodology.

• Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools in a research workflow  e.g. LLM-assisted analysis, AI-assisted qual coding, or evaluating AI-powered research tooling  with a critical eye on validity and bias.

• AI-curious practitioner who can speak critically about AI's limits as well as its power; collaborates fluently with qual, data science, and product analysts.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work closely with diverse teams and present data-driven findings in an engaging and accessible way.

What’s in it for you:

• A range of flexible working options to dedicate time to what matters to you

• Competitive compensation package + bonus

• 25 days holiday per year, with an extra 5 days holiday allocated after your 1 year anniversary (prorated)

• Two (paid) volunteering days a year to spend your time giving back to the causes that matter to you and your community

• Rich learning and development opportunities are supported through the Trustpilot Academy and Blinkist

• Comprehensive health package, pension, and full access to Headspace, a popular mindfulness app to promote positive mental health

• Paid parental leave

• Central office with  a laid-back vibe and constant buzz of different languages being spoken everywhere you go It’s complete with a coffee bar, canteen, and table tennis and has a wide variety of refreshments available - you can opt-in for breakfast and lunch at an affordable price

• Regular opportunities to connect and get to know your fellow Trusties, including company-wide celebrations and events, ERG activities, and team socials

Product Specialist - Technical Support & Data Analysis

About ChemoMetec

ChemoMetec is a worldwide leading manufacturer of cell counting and analysis equipment. We specialize in developing and producing high-precision instrumentation, delivering consistent data for thousands of customers across biotech, pharma, and academic segments.

About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and analytically skilled Product Specialist - Technical Support & Data Analysis to support customers and colleagues using our cell-counting instruments. In this role, you will combine cell culture biology with data analysis to help users achieve reliable results, investigate unexpected data, and turn insights into product improvements. The ideal candidate holds a PhD in a relevant field, has hands-on cell culture experience, and enjoys working with data in Python.

We are hiring two Product Specialists for our technical support team: one focused on data analysis and one on documentation. You will be part of the Product Management Department and work closely with R&D, QA, Field Application Scientists, and commercial teams. You will provide application and technical support, analyze instrument and experimental data, and contribute to the successful testing and launch of new products.

This position is based at our headquarters. The role includes occasional travel, both domestically and internationally, depending on needs.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide application and technical support for our instruments, helping customers and colleagues with assay setup, sample preparation, and interpretation of results.

• Analyze customer and internal data sets to identify the root causes of unexpected results and recommend solutions.

• Write and maintain Python scripts to automate data analysis, visualization, and reporting.

• Design and analyze experiments and comparison studies for new features and product releases.

• Support product launches with a focus on application readiness, validation data, and training.

• Contribute to technical documentation, including application notes, troubleshooting guides, and data analysis protocols.

• Assist in troubleshooting instrument software, including reading logs to support root cause analysis.

Qualifications

• PhD in Cell Biology, Biotechnology, Biomedical Science, or a related field.

• Hands-on experience with cell culture and common cell-based assays.

• Solid statistical knowledge, including experimental design and method comparison (e.g., precision, linearity, and regression analysis).

• Strong data analysis and data visualization skills.

• Experience with Python scripting for data analysis (e.g., pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib).

• Familiarity with pharmaceutical workflows and regulated lab environments (e.g., GMP) is a strong advantage.

• Structured, curious, and detail-oriented, with a passion for problem-solving.

Preferred Skills

• Experience with software debugging and troubleshooting, such as reading code and log files.

• Experience with cell counting, image cytometry, flow cytometry, or microscopy.

**

Why join ChemoMetec?**

At ChemoMetec, we believe that great people make a great workplace. We value both personal and professional development and offer an environment where you can grow, take responsibility, and make an impact. You will become part of a team of talented and supportive colleagues who enjoy working together in an informal and welcoming atmosphere. We also believe that strong relationships go beyond the workplace, which is why we regularly bring colleagues together through company-wide events to build connections and strengthen relationships across the organization.

**

Practical information**

Both positions are on-site at our HQ in Allerød, Denmark. You will refer to Director, Ph.D. Product Management Bassam Tawfik.

Starting date is as soon as possible, and we conduct interviews on an ongoing basis. Deadline for applying is 20 November 2026.

PEAK Wind is seeking a consultant to support product and project delivery across Data & Intelligence. You will help drive the delivery of our data, analytics, reporting, and digital solutions. Introducing the Data & Intelligence Team

You will become part of our Data & Intelligence (D&I) team, where we work within PEAK Wind’s operations management service offering and manage full value chain data management for our clients. We support renewable energy assets worldwide through data management, reporting solutions, analytics, digital products, and AI capabilities, helping deliver data-driven solutions that support our clients and renewable energy projects. You will coordinate day-to-day delivery with data engineers, data scientists, developers, and renewable energy specialists, while acting as a clear and trusted point of contact for clients and internal stakeholders.

How You Will Make an Impact

In this role, you will combine product ownership with project delivery, turning business and client needs into well-defined, commercially sound, and successfully delivered D&I solutions. You will take ownership of selected products and projects, create structure around delivery, and ensure that commitments move from proposal and plan to implementation, adoption, and follow-up.

Your work will span both recurring services and new opportunities. This includes day-to-day ownership of selected digital products, coordination of analytics and reporting solutions based on operational and SCADA data, and delivery of selected AI and automation initiatives. You will help ensure that our products and services solve real operational problems rather than becoming isolated technical exercises.

On smaller assignments, you may own the full process from client dialogue and scoping through delivery and handover. On larger assignments, you will work with a multidisciplinary team and keep scope, responsibilities, budget, timeline, quality, and stakeholder expectations aligned. • Own and coordinate selected D&I client projects and internal initiatives from initial need and scoping through delivery, adoption, and follow-up

• Translate operational and commercial challenges into clear requirements, work packages, priorities, acceptance criteria, and delivery plans for technical teams

• Take day-to-day ownership of selected digital products and reporting solutions, including backlog management, stakeholder coordination, implementation planning, user feedback, and continuous improvement

• Coordinate analytics and reporting use cases involving SCADA data, availability, production losses, alarms, asset performance, and operational reporting

• Support proposals and commercial scoping by defining deliverables, assumptions, team setup, effort, pricing input, risks, dependencies, and expected client value

• Act as the link between clients, renewable energy specialists, Product Owners, data engineers, data scientists, and software developers

• Manage delivery governance, including progress tracking, budgets, risks, decisions, actions, dependencies, and clear communication to stakeholders

• Drive selected AI, reporting, and automation initiatives together with technical specialists, ensuring that solutions are useful, governed, and adopted

• Challenge requests constructively, clarify the underlying problem, and recommend a simpler or non-technical solution when that creates better value

• Create clear documentation, client material, handovers, and ways of working so solutions can be operated, supported, and scaled

• Capture lessons learned and contribute to D&I frameworks, templates, playbooks, product roadmaps, and continuous improvement across PEAK Wind

What Will Make You Successful in This Role

At PEAK Wind, we know success comes in many forms. What matters most is your ability to create clarity, build trust, and get valuable work delivered. The following qualities and experiences will help you succeed in this role:

• A degree in engineering, renewable energy, data, business, project management, or a related field, or an equivalent track record from technical consulting or digital delivery

• Experience managing client-facing projects, digital products, analytics solutions, or operational improvement initiatives from scope to implementation

• A strong understanding of project and product delivery, including requirements, prioritisation, planning, budgets, risks, stakeholder management, and handover

• The ability to work across commercial, operational, and technical topics and translate effectively between specialists and decision-makers

• Experience preparing proposals, scopes of work, estimates, presentations, or business cases, with an understanding of how delivery choices affect client value and profitability

• Professional experience in renewable energy, asset management, operational analytics, or another complex technical environment; wind operations, SCADA, availability, or performance reporting experience is a strong advantage

• Familiarity with data and digital products such as Power BI, APIs, cloud platforms, reporting systems, workflow automation, or AI-enabled solutions; hands-on software development is not required

• Clear and effective communication skills in English, both spoken and written, and confidence working directly with clients and senior stakeholders

• A structured and pragmatic approach to problem-solving, with the initiative to create momentum when requirements are incomplete or responsibilities are unclear

• Sound commercial judgement, attention to detail, and the ability to balance quality, timeline, effort, and business value

• A collaborative mindset and the ability to stay calm, constructive, and accountable in an international, cross-functional environment

We care more about your ability to structure ambiguity, build strong relationships, and deliver useful outcomes than about a specific job title or number of years.

Why Join PEAK Wind

• A central role in shaping and delivering data, analytics, reporting, and digital solutions that directly support renewable energy assets and client decision-making

• An international, inclusive, and diverse workplace where differences are valued

• The opportunity to work on leading renewable energy projects alongside experienced industry professionals

• A broad role with direct exposure to clients, commercial decisions, operational challenges, and modern data and AI solutions

• A flat organisational structure where you can take ownership, challenge constructively, and see the result of your work

• A strong focus on your learning, development, and professional growth across product, project, commercial, and renewable energy disciplines

• A culture that values commitment, meaningful contributions, and having fun

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Fair Hiring

We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace drives innovation, creativity, and stronger results. At PEAK Wind, we are committed to fair and transparent hiring processes, welcoming candidates from all backgrounds, identities, and experiences. Our hiring decisions focus on what each person brings to the role and our team, and we are committed to ensuring transparent salary structures, with pay decisions based on clear, objective, and gender‑neutral criteria. Salary information, including the relevant salary band, will be shared with candidates when they are invited to a first interview.

How to Apply

We look forward to receiving your application. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we reserve the right to close the recruitment process once the right candidate has been found.
